observations: Photo 0 shows the back/outer shell of a PlayStation console with the 'PS' logo centered.
The console appears to be a PS4 model (slim-style back panel is suggested by the overall shape, but the exact 'slim' variant is not clearly confirmed from this single angle).
No controller (pad), cables, games, ports, or power-on screen are shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Clean Sonny PS4 slim station with 8 to 10 games installed and one pad
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows the console shell; no games list, storage screen, or controller is visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/inspection photos or warranty seal/inspection evidence shown.
No temperature/usage test, no gameplay session, no fan noise/thermal test shown.
No close-up of ports or demonstration of HDMI/USB/audio working shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No pad(s) or receipt photo shown.

risks.risk: Exact model/variant not confirmed (PS4 vs PS4 Slim vs other), which affects pricing and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console front model label/serial sticker (or the exact model number on the back/underside) plus a photo of the front ports area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 console with unknown variant.

risks.risk: Controller/pad may be missing, non-original, or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of the included controller(s) with visible brand/label and a short clip showing it pairing and working in a game/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no working original pad included).

risks.risk: Games installed may be fewer than claimed, or storage may be low/partially corrupted.
risks.proof: Photo of the 'Games' library screen showing installed titles and storage capacity, or a video scrolling the library.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console with no guaranteed installed games.

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/controller ports), or console may have intermittent issues.
risks.proof: Video showing HDMI output to TV and at least one USB device/controller connected and working; close-up photos of all ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fully functional (worst case for buyer).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may exist despite the claim.
risks.proof: Short gameplay/benchmark clip (10–15 minutes) with fan behavior and no shutdowns, ideally with a temperature readout app if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst case).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” may be false; console could have been repaired or serviced.
risks.proof: Photos of warranty/void stickers (if any), and a clear view of the underside/serial label; optionally a photo of internal seals if accessible without opening.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model/serial label (back/underside) so the exact PS4 variant is confirmed.
Photo(s) of the included controller/pad(s) showing brand/label, plus a short clip of it working (pairing + menu navigation).
Photo or video of the PS4 home screen showing installed games library and storage capacity.
Close-up photos of all ports (HDMI, USB, power, etc.) and a short video demonstrating HDMI output and USB/controller connection working.
response.reason: From the single photo, the console type is only roughly suggested and none of the key value claims (exact PS4 slim variant, included pad, installed games, port functionality, overheating test, receipt) are verifiable. Missing proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
